paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.61% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.45%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.46%). Brent crude changed +5.43% to 111.43. Gold changed -0.90% to 4,139.7002. Bitcoin changed -0.88% to 81,421.7188. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.136%, a relative move of -1.98%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (-8.91%) and Citigroup (-7.75%) moved the most.
